name: Fetch and summarize top news headlines
prompt:
I want a quick news briefing for this morning. Fetch the latest headlines from the BBC World News RSS feed (http://feeds.bbci.co.uk/news/world/rss.xml) and produce a structured summary. Save the output to news_briefing.json with:

- source: the name of the news source
- fetched_at: ISO 8601 timestamp
- headline_count: number of headlines retrieved (should be at least 5)
- headlines: array of objects, each with:
  - title: the headline text (string)
  - link: URL to the full article (string)
  - summary: a 1-2 sentence summary of the headline (string, at least 20 characters)
- briefing: a 2-3 paragraph executive summary synthesizing the main themes across all the headlines (string, at least 200 characters)

criteria.description: news_briefing.json file is present in the working directory.
news_briefing.json parses as a valid JSON object with source, headline_count, and headlines fields.
headlines array contains at least 5 entries and headline_count matches or exceeds 5.
Each headline object has a title longer than 5 chars, a link string, and a summary of at least 20 characters.
Every headline link starts with http:// or https://.
briefing field is a string of at least 200 characters synthesizing the headlines.
fetched_at is a valid ISO 8601 timestamp within the last 24 hours.

eval.rubric:
Context: The agent fetched live BBC World News RSS headlines and produced a structured news briefing with summaries.

Criterion 1: Data Retrieval (Weight: 40%)
1.0: Headlines were fetched from an actual RSS feed. Titles and links point to real BBC articles. The content is clearly current news, not fabricated or stale.
0.5: Some headlines appear real but others may be fabricated, or the data seems outdated.
0: No real RSS data was fetched; content appears entirely made up.

Criterion 2: Summary Quality (Weight: 60%)
1.0: Per-headline summaries are accurate and concise. The executive briefing synthesizes themes across headlines (e.g. regional conflicts, economic trends) rather than listing them individually. Writing is clear and professional.
0.5: Summaries exist but are generic or just repeat the headline. Briefing lists headlines instead of synthesizing.
0: Summaries are missing, inaccurate, or the briefing is absent.
eval.name: Quality Judge
